purpose: Explicit unresolved boundaries of a Python dependency SBOM; not license exemptions or legal authorization.

known_exceptions.reason: Model weights and trained checkpoints are not Python runtime packages and require individual provenance, usage and redistribution review.
Hosted inference API contracts, provider terms and output rights do not follow from Python-client package license metadata.
Photographs, datasets, image masks, fonts and generated artwork retain separate rights and cannot be cleared by the Python dependency audit.
Absent or legacy non-SPDX package metadata cannot be interpreted as redistribution approval until authoritative package/source terms are verified.
